key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keybinding that opens and closes the Spotlight overlay.

key.name: web-prefixes
key.description: Entries in the form "token|Label|url prefix". Typing "token query" in the search box opens the URL prefix plus the query in your default browser. For example, the default "-g|Google|https://www.google.com/search?q=" makes "-G potatoes" search Google for potatoes.

key.name: hotwords
key.description: Entries in the form "word|type|target". Type is one of url (open a webpage in the default browser), command (run a shell command) or system (lock, logout, suspend, restart, poweroff). When the word is typed in the search box it is highlighted and bolded, and pressing Enter runs its action. For example, the default "youtube|url|https://www.youtube.com" opens YouTube when you type "youtube" and press Enter.

key.name: panel-width
key.description: Width of the Spotlight search panel. Must be greater than 0.

key.name: panel-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels of the Spotlight search text entry.

key.name: panel-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the Spotlight search panel in pixels.

key.name: panel-opacity
key.description: Background opacity of the Spotlight search panel (0.0 fully transparent to 1.0 fully opaque).

key.name: panel-y-offset
key.description: Position of the panel from the top of the screen, as a percentage of the monitor height.

key.name: theme
key.description: Color theme of the search panel: default, light, midnight, ocean, glass or blur.

key.name: enable-glow
key.description: Adds a soft colored halo around the search panel, like macOS Spotlight.

key.name: max-results
key.description: Maximum number of search results shown at once.

key.name: search-files
key.description: Whether the Spotlight overlay searches your home directory, media mounts and removable drives for matching files.

key.name: search-depth
key.description: How many directory levels to descend when searching files. Set to -1 for no limit.

key.name: max-entries
key.description: Hard cap on how many files/directories each file search scans (Everything-style sweeps are bounded to stay responsive).

key.name: max-matches
key.description: Maximum number of file results returned per search.

key.name: web-suggestions
key.description: While you type, show up to three live web search suggestions below the other results. Pressing Enter on one opens it in your default browser. Requires network access.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.description: Watch the system clipboard and remember recently copied text. Typing "clip" and a search term shows matching entries that you can copy again with Enter. Copied text is only stored locally.

key.name: clipboard-history-size
key.description: Maximum number of recent clipboard entries to remember. Must be greater than 0.
